'''Strellis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] she ran a stall within the Republic controlled [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]]. Strellis had no hair, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and yellow skin. While at her stall she wore white [[Armor/Legends|armor]] marked with the Republic's emblem, brown robes, a golden headband and spoke in a language other than [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|basic]] to her customers.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Strellis appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Equipment Commendations Vendor for Republic players on Corellia.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Strellis was removed from the game along with the rest of the Equipment Commendations Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> Her position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
